subject: Re: Private VPC pricing & next steps - follow up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T18:34:00Z
Subject: Private VPC pricing & next steps - recap from today's call

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and the concrete asks I promised to pull together:

Summary of what we heard
- Use case: real-time fraud detection + customer support summarization (low-latency requirements for auth flows).
- Deployment: Private VPC (customer-managed networking) with dedicated inference nodes in us-east.
- Environments: staging + prod initially; dev environment optional for integration testing.
- Expected traffic: pilot 1B tokens/month, production steady state ~3B tokens/month, peak up to 5B tokens/month during promos.

Initial commercial model (high level)
- One-time/annual licensing: recommended Enterprise Private license (covers runtime + control plane) — ballpark $200k–$350k/year depending on environment count and SLA.
- Per-token processing fee: commonly structured as $/1M tokens for active inference. Based on your volumes, we expect a blended unit target in the range of $200–$350 per 1M tokens.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 8x5) included; Premium (24x7 with SRE hours + dedicated TAM) is an add-on — typically +$75k–$150k/year.
- Environment multiplier: each additional production environment or DR cluster generally increases license by a fixed increment (we modeled +$25k/env).

What I attached
- RIF-PrivatePricing-Estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet) — initial numbers and three packaging options (starter pilot, growth, enterprise).
- SOC2-summary.pdf — quick security/compliance snapshot you asked for.

Open questions from our side
1) Can you confirm whether the staging environment needs to be geo-redundant (multi-region) or single-region?
2) Will FintechCo require a fully air-gapped on-prem package for any of the environments?
3) Any procurement constraints on PO vs signed SOW timeline?

Next steps
- I can send a tailored quote + SOW for the option you prefer (pilot vs enterprise).
- If you want, Marissa (cc'd) can run through the cost math and show the $/1M token sensitivity at different compression/quantization profiles.
- Proposed timing: aim to have SOW + redlines to Procurement by 2026-03-09.

If this looks right, I'll send the tailored quote tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing & next steps - recap from today's call

Ben —

Appreciate the clear recap and the estimate. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: the 3B/month steady-state is our middle-case; we want the pilot to be constrained to 1B cap. Peak 5B is rare but we need graceful degradation fallback.
- Environments: we definitely need prod + staging; dev can be a shared internal env (so not counted as full prod). Also want a DR plan but not a full-time DR cluster to start.
- Support: premium seems likely given SLAs for real-time fraud. Could you break down precisely what Premium includes (SRE hours, SLA targets, escalation path)?
- Target price: Procurement has signaled a target blended unit of ~$250 per 1M tokens (this is what finance is comfortable with). Can you show an option that hits that at 3B tokens/month?

Procurement has been looped in to start standard information requests. They will want the SOC2 and a short vendor questionnaire — I downloaded the SOC2-summary you attached and shared it internally.

We'd like the tailored SOW by next Tuesday (2026-03-03). Can you make that timeline?

Thanks —
Aisha Malik
Head of Engineering, FintechCo

Aisha —

Yes, we can meet that $250/1M tokens blended target for the 3B/month profile in the Growth packaging by tightening a few levers:

- Commitment: hitting $250/1M requires a 12–18 month committed volume (we'll model a ramp to 3B/month over 3 months).
- Quantization & runtime optimizations: with medium quantization and auto-batching we expect 15–30% cost improvement vs baseline. We'll include the quantified assumptions in the SOW.
- License profile: for the Growth tier we propose $250k/year license + per-token fee at $250/1M to arrive at an annual cost that meets your finance constraints.

- Support: Premium tier includes 24x7 on-call, weekly SRE syncs, 40 SRE hours/month, an assigned TAM, and 99.9% platform uptime SLA (credits for breaches). Premium uplift in the quote is +$125k/year.

I've asked Marissa to prepare a sensitivity worksheet that shows total cost at 1B/3B/5B and different $/1M token bands — that will be in the SOW packet.

Will plan to get the SOW + quote over to you by 2026-03-02 EOD. If Procurement needs anything faster (e.g., vendor questionnaire) ping me and I'll prioritize.

Ben
